title: Exercised, Rarely Recovered: What Public Reports Say About Recovery in 50 AI Agent Harnesses and Runtimes
abstract: arXiv:2611.27090v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When an AI coding agent deletes the wrong files or a long agent run crashes, users fall back on recovery mechanisms: resume from a checkpoint, undo, ask for approval, read the log. Research runtimes promise stronger guarantees, such as saga-style compensation and transactional rollback. We ask what public evidence shows about whether either kind works in real use. Under a protocol frozen before data collection, we graded 12 persistent agent runtimes, 26 coding-agent harnesses and 12 research runtimes on eight recovery mechanisms, from not found to exercised in a real run, with two blind coding passes, adjudication and re-verification against archived sources. Recovery is exercised almost everywhere in practice: 11 of 12 runtimes and 25 of 26 harnesses have at least one real-use report. Yet of 128 such reports, only 19 describe the run fully recovering; 54 are partial and 45 failed. Checkpoint/resume recovered once in 27 reports, rollba

translated_title: 有使用、少恢复：50个AI智能体框架与运行时的公开报告揭示了恢复机制的实际情况
translated_abstract: 当AI编程智能体删除了错误的文件，或一次长时间的智能体运行崩溃时，用户只能依赖恢复机制：从检查点恢复、撤销、请求批准、读取日志等。研究型运行时承诺更强的保障，例如saga式补偿和事务性回滚。我们探究公开证据是否表明这两类机制在真实使用中确实有效。在一个在数据收集前即已冻结的协议下，我们对12个持久化智能体运行时、26个编程智能体框架和12个研究型运行时的八种恢复机制进行评分，评分等级从“未发现”到“在真实运行中被实际使用”，并采用两次盲评编码、裁决机制以及对存档来源的重新验证。结果显示，恢复机制在实践中几乎普遍被使用：12个运行时中有11个、26个框架中有25个至少有一份真实使用报告。然而，在128份此类报告中，只有19份描述了运行完全恢复；54份为部分恢复，45份失败。检查点/恢复机制在27份报告中仅有一次实现恢复，回滚机制……
tldr: 该研究在预设协议下对50个AI智能体框架与运行时的八种恢复机制进行系统评估，发现恢复机制虽在实践中被广泛使用，但128份真实使用报告中仅19份实现完全恢复，大部分以部分恢复或失败告终。
en_tdlr: By grading 50 AI agent harnesses and runtimes on eight recovery mechanisms under a pre-frozen protocol, this study finds that recovery is widely exercised in practice, yet only 19 of 128 real-use reports describe full recovery, with most ending partial or failed.
